falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price increases by 10% or more over the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant upward move would contradict the blowoff score and suggest the pattern is not forming as expected.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume remains below 30% of the 20-day average for the entire 14-day period
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained low volume would indicate lack of participation, invalidating the blowoff scenario which typically requires high-volume extremes.

falsification_conditions.condition: The MACD indicator crosses above the signal line with a bullish divergence
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed bullish technical signal would directly contradict the current HOLD verdict and blowoff pattern expectations.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
